feature_semantics.direction: public inbound traffic; counters grouped by remote/protocol/local-port tuple
feature_semantics.packet_scope: UDP packets and TCP SYN packets without ACK; other TCP packets bypass this model
feature_semantics.packet_rate: window packet_count / configured window duration in seconds
feature_semantics.mean_packet_bytes: mean total IP packet length in bytes for counted packets

source.mapping_note: Accepted only if each row is a single 1-second inbound window with runtime feature semantics.
source.label_join: bidirectional IP 5-tuple + minute-resolution CICFlowMeter timestamp bucket and flow duration (100 ms tolerance); conflicting labels excluded

validation.reason: A class appears in fewer than two independent traffic groups; a class-complete group-held-out split cannot be made without leakage.

deployment_context.user_scenario: YouTube live broadcast through OBS while coding on a low-to-medium connection
deployment_context.scenario_coverage: not measured by this public dataset; needs benign captures from the target PC
deployment_context.outbound_video: outside this inbound packet feature stream

split.reason: A class appears in fewer than two independent traffic groups; a class-complete group-held-out split cannot be made without leakage.

limitations: Only one public capture slice was used; the DDoS class occurs in one traffic group, so no class-complete group-held-out score is available.
CIC-IDS2017 flow labels have minute precision; the conversion manifest records the matching and ambiguity policy.
Runtime sees only UDP and TCP SYN-without-ACK; it does not classify established TCP payload traffic.
Counters are per remote/protocol/local-port key; distributed low-rate attacks spread across many keys may evade per-key thresholds.
The requested OBS, YouTube broadcast, and coding workload has not been measured; outbound video is outside this model's feature stream.
